about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers diagnostics and engine work, brakes, steering and suspension, exhaust and underbody. We work out of North Myrtle Beach and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Adam Booten
reviews.text: I pulled in after closing on a Friday leading into a holiday weekend and asked the guy about a new tire. He politely said they didn’t have it in stock but threw some air in it to make sure I could get home. I appreciated it!

reviews.author: Evan West
reviews.text: Got a nail in my tire and came in to get it fixed. I was in and out in 20 mins, fastest service ive had. Much appreciated!

reviews.author: Amy Rusch
reviews.text: The guys that work there are always so friendly and ready to help me when I walk in stressed out about problems with my car. If they dont have the part at their shop they quickly find where they can get it from! I wouldn't go anywhere else!

reviews.author: Scott Monahan
reviews.text: This garage was excellent, professional, and courteous! Brett was awesome and explained everything to me and what they were doing to fix my problem. I was in vacation traveling from New York state and I needed a mechanic so I found this place with great reviews. I am happy that I did cause they fixed my problem. I recommend this place to anyone who needs a good mechanic!

reviews.author: Matt Himes
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Caleb and crew, called this morning he got me right in. Angel the mechanic was fantastic put the car on the lift found a couple bolts loose he tightened them up and I was on my way. Angel took the time to explain everything in great detail and was also very professional. I’ll be back for any other issues with my vehicle.

reviews.author: Jim
reviews.text: The professionalism at this garage was clearly lacking. The gent that helped us was nice. The receptionist was not. What should have been a $300 job at best, that I could have easily done myself if I was home, to almost $1,000. Fortunately I had the opportunity to back out when they received the wrong part, but still had to pay $350ish for a disassemble/reassemble fee. I count myself lucky.

reviews.author: Hallie Young
reviews.text: We had a dying car battery the day before leaving town. I called and they squeezed us in same day to test our battery, order a new one, & install a replacement. The lady at the front desk was kind and efficient and the guy working on our car worked through his lunch to get us in and out in a timely manner. We felt the prices were fair and everyone we dealt with was wonderful! Hopefully no more car emergencies on vacation, but if you’re in the same boat I would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Claire Kaplan
reviews.text: The AC went out on my car when it was 82 degrees out. I had heard several recommendations on Pop's Garage. I had to get my AC fixed and didn't know anywhere else to go so I went to Pop's. They didn't have an open appointment for 2 days, but it's so hot out this week the guy said he'd fix it for me right then. 15 minutes later I was on my way with very cold AC. The price was very reasonable. I'll definitely go back there again if anything else goes wrong with my car! Update: 3 months later my horn stopped working. Now I knew ahead of time to make an appointment, especially since it wasn't an emergency. I called, made the appointment, got there on time and I was out in a hour with a working car horn at again a reasonable price. Big bonus: they were cutting up a yellow watermelon which I've never heard of. They offered me a piece and it was very good! Update: I have since been back there 2 more times and have not been disappointed. Again, they fixed the problems quickly and for reasonable prices. I'm so glad I found them! It's not easy to find a good mechanic you can trust!

reviews.author: Robby Rob
reviews.text: These guys do fantastic work. I dropped off my 1994 Bronco around 8am in the morning for a new radiator and they did a great job. They're a very knowledgeable and friendly staff.

reviews.author: L Track
reviews.text: I’m 600 miles from home with my family and my check engine light comes on. (Just got car inspected in July, and oil change and some work) code read small leak in a hose and they assured me I was okay to drive home. Quick easy process, friendly and good people. Called the day before and she got me right in. They also had a dog they rescued in the lobby, my kids were in heaven. Good place, didn’t rip me off, and easily could have

reviews.author: Jason Hamrick
reviews.text: The owner knows how to get stuff done. If you are from out of town on vacation and have a problem they will handle it

reviews.author: Mitch Grant
reviews.text: Pop's is great! Everyone there is experienced, professional and caring. I trust Pop's completely and have done so for many years with my cars and truck. Today, September 2022, my truck needs serving. Took it in and a mechanic got right on it and I had a diagnosis and estimate within an hour. These are trustworthy professionals. Highly recommend you give them a try. They deserve more than 5 stars.

reviews.author: Erin
reviews.text: I went in unscheduled and was seen right away for a tire puncture. Receptionist and service tech both super helpful and friendly. They had me in and out in under 20 minutes (would have been sooner if the metal bar in my tire wasn’t being so difficult to remove). Very very affordable. They saved the last days of my vacation. Highly highly recommend.

reviews.author: Paul Hammaker
reviews.text: The dealership where we bought our car didn’t have any time in the next week to check what was wrong with our car. The wonderful people from Pop’s Garage fixed our car the day we called them. We’ll definitely be back if we have any more problems.

reviews.author: Cliff Bowers
reviews.text: Pops garage has been taking care of our cars for the past 5 years. Great people and service! Had a problem with my 350Z last week. Took in and Angel thought he had resolved the problem but a few days later I was still having issues. Took it back today and problem was resolved. No charge. All I have ever wanted is good work and honesty. Pops provides both. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alanna Thompson
reviews.text: Today, the owner of Pop's Garage saved my vacation. I called and told them I was from out of town, they immediately said to bring my Lexus in. I was so upset about the potential downtime and cost. We pulled up and he immediately went to work on it and was able to find that it was simply a rock that was in between my exhaust and frame. He has no idea how much of a Knight in Shining Armor he was for me. May The Lord Bless them and their business.

reviews.author: Allen Ramsey
reviews.text: Pop's Garage & Alignment provides exceptional maintenance services for all of my vehicles. From the moment I walked in, their knowledgeable and friendly staff made me feel confident in their abilities. Their skilled technicians handle routine maintenance and complex repairs with precision and transparency. They deliver efficient service without compromising quality, and at very fair pricing. Pop's Garage has earned my trust, and I highly recommend them to anyone seeking reliable automotive maintenance.

reviews.author: Warren Brooks
reviews.text: Really nice people to work with. Their estimate for my vehicle electrical issues was spot on and they were ahead of schedule for the fix! I highly recommend them (not to mention Bolineaus Store and buffet is walking distance).

reviews.author: R Lawton
reviews.text: Today, around 12noon I stopped at Pops Garage. Was having problems with my 2011 Chevy Equinox, the owner immediately took a look at my car. Being from Pittsburgh I did not know this gentleman. With out having an appointment he assigned a technician to fix the car. A short time later , back on the road again. Very reasonable, possibly too reasonable.. Treated an out of towner with compassion and fairness. I AM GREATFUL. THANK YOU, FROM THE HEART. ROBERT

reviews.author: Carrie Suggs
reviews.text: I’m very disappointed with this shop. Had my car towed there and they said it needed a new battery which I thought was strange since the car had power just wouldn’t start. The key was also broken and they told me it had to be replaced asap because eventually it wouldn’t start al all because of the security system. Ok cool. How much for the battery? $400.00. What???? Even with labor I thought that was ridiculous so I said no I’ll come get it cause they got it started with a jump. So I paid $105.00 for diagnostics and went home and bought a battery from Walmart for $100.00 and put it in myself. Still won’t start. Turns out it was the key all along. Even if it really did need a battery (which it didn’t) $400 is crazy to me. I thought I had found my new mechanic, guess not.

reviews.author: Steve Hawkins
reviews.text: Used this place for years, but not any more. Prices are high and service isn’t what it used to be. Had tires installed here recently and have been back 3 times. Was charged for valve stems that should have been installed to begin with. Plus tire pressure wasn’t correct. My advice, get a quote and compare prices. You won’t be using Pops. Call Chris at Motor Masters, better price and he’ll get the job done the first time. You won’t have to go back three times to get the job done right. Disappointing.

reviews.author: Angie Byrd
reviews.text: Had a low tire on our way home. Pulled into Pops. Found a nail in the tire; plugged it, got air in it and we were on our way within 15 minutes. Great experience! Highly recommend for all of your automotive needs in the Cherry Grove area!

reviews.author: Mike Adkins
reviews.text: Tom and the folks at Pops were very pleasant and helpful. performed repairs for me on my ford truck quickly as I was on vacation and leaving soon thereafter. Price was reasonable and work was excellent. I would recommend them wholeheartedly. Many thanks to all of them.

reviews.author: Melissa Ferguson
reviews.text: In and out in less than 10 minutes to get my tire plugged. I had no appointment and didn’t call, just walked in and had it repaired efficiently and for cheap. I appreciate the great customer service!!

reviews.author: JoAnn Harris
reviews.text: As a local, I can say this is hands down the most honest, reliable mechanic shop in town. I showed up needing a repair on a tire that had a slow leak. They didn't charge me anything to repair the tire so of course, when I needed work done on my SUV I came back. They were amazing got me right in and didn't overcharge me. If you need any mechanical work or tires for your vehicle...no need to look any further. I highly recommend Pops.

reviews.author: Kevin Rieck
reviews.text: Super friendly & honest. I had a screw in my tread. The mechanic removed the screw and tested to see if it penetrated the tire (which it didn't). He told me I was lucky & to go play the lottery. :-) They didn't charge me anything, even the mechanic's time. I tipped the mechanic & promised to bring my vehicle back for its next oil change. I'd feel comfortable bringing my vehicles to Pop's for most mechanical needs.

reviews.author: Wendell Whitted
reviews.text: We were on vacation and I noticed issues with my vehicle pulling to the left, I was concerned about using someone I was not familiar with plus being out of town and I looked up alignment services in the area and Pops had good reviews and I gave them a call they set up an appointment the following day . I found them to be just as the reviews stated . They did really good work at a Fair price and resolved my issue. I would recommend Pops to Locals or tourists as well . Thanks and God Bless

reviews.author: Julie Todd
reviews.text: Pop's was suggested by a good friend as well as from several locals, and it is conveniently maybe a mile from home. My 2014 Town and Country was having a no start no crank issue along with the infamous oil cooler housing leak, which is in turn what caused my starter to burn out and crap out. I contacted Pop's on a Friday, told them what was going on and what my suspicion was (Thomas was super nice and knowledgeable about my vehicle's issue), I then had AAA tow it in around noonish, and I received a call by 3:30 ish, confirming my suspicions and an estimate. ($672 for the starter, $748 for the new upgraded aluminum oil cooler housing). I do feel that their prices are a little on the higher side, but just a little. But I wanted to support a local small business. Always remember you do get what you pay for and not all auto work should be scrimped on. They are closed on the weekends, so they started on my girl first thing Monday and she was ready to pickup by noonish. I am pleased with the work that was done and it was done pretty quickly, which is important to this busy mom of 3. I hope to not have to see them for a while, but most definitely will be my first call if I need work done again. Thanks guys, I appreciate ya!

reviews.author: William Lynch
reviews.text: We have used Pop’s Garage a few times. They are the friendliest in town, from Alex in the office to the owner Tom and their mechanics. Very knowledgeable. Angel added a power brake booster on our classic car. He took his time and was very careful not to scratch the paint. Highly recommend this shop.

reviews.author: Mike L
reviews.text: I'm an out of stater and had a 900+ mile trip back to Michigan on my hands. They went above and beyond and found issues that needed to be fixed when I simply though I needed new brakes. They were honest and kind and even gave me a lift to and from our vacation spot. The prices are fair and gave me 2 year warranty on all parts from locations throughout the nation. I highly recommend them. Better than any experience I have had in Michigan.

reviews.author: Thomas Waltz
reviews.text: Needed an urgent repair. Just made it into South Carolina and the Check battery light kicked on. Systems began to light up needing attention. An auto parts store checked and said I needed a new alternator. They Recommended Pops. Monday morning walked to Pops and was able to schedule repairs same day. They were amazing and I really appreciate them being able to help me same day. Can’t thank them enough.

reviews.author: Jeremy Adams
reviews.text: I had an issue with a brake caliper where I was towed and was literally 10 hours from home. My vehicle was towed, dropped off at 10, and fixed by 1. The staff were great and very helpful in a very tough spot. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!! Thanks Pop’s Garage!!!!

reviews.author: Paul Johnson
reviews.text: We were in Cherry Grove for our 25th Anniversary and managed to pick up a screw in our tire. They were able to check it immediately, and informed us it hadn't actually punctured the tire. I offered to pay, and they refused! Super nice people!

reviews.author: Ryan Fayette
reviews.text: It’s hard to trust some mechanics now a days but this is BY FAR the best experience I’ve ever had. They’re extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and affordable! My buddy Brett Roberts knows how to keep customers satisfied and he will do whatever it takes to do so! Great guy, and extremely good mechanic! So the next time you need a mechanic please consider POP'S Garage! Trust me, you won’t be disappointed!!! Ask for Brett Roberts! He will take care of you

reviews.author: Larry Stevens
reviews.text: I took my classic 1967 Ford Galaxie here with a brake problem. It has been customized, so going by the manual didn't help much in making the repairs. They took the time to diagnose the problem and make some very time consuming repairs and didn't charge me an outrageous fee. The brakes are working great and the job was done in a timely manner. I highly recommend this shop not only for quality work but also for their honesty and fairness! Thank you Pop's Garage!!

reviews.author: Jamie Marshall
reviews.text: We have been having an ongoing problem with our 2000 Toyota Landcruiser not starting periodically. We were referred to Pop’s Garage. We came from out of state and were worried about where to go to see someone we could trust and the expense. They detected the problem and fixed it within 1 day for a very fair price! We are satisfied customers and POP’s garage is our new Auto Shop. We highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Drake
reviews.text: Pop's...Such friendly and efficient service! We just needed some air in our low tires and they took the time to do it right now, not having us to wait. Completely different from any place else. Whenever we visit North Myrtle Beach and need any car issues taken care of we'll be sure to go to Pop's.

reviews.author: Matthew Hill
reviews.text: This is what the owner and manager said to me, a military veteran, when I told him that they damaged my son‘s Cadillac. He denied it and said I was lying and trolling the Facebook group that we were in, but I showed receipts of me being there With the Cadillac in question, then he proceeded to email me personally and say these things. Garage is a scam with horrible employees who could care less about your vehicle

reviews.author: Michael Driver
reviews.text: I've been driving around for 15 minutes looking for somebody that had a working air pump so I can put some air in my daughter's tire. On a whim I pulled in here and asked and they not only pumped up the tire, they refused the money I was going to give them. If I ever have any other issue with any of my cars while I'm down here at my condo I know where I'm going. These guys are awesome.

reviews.author: Shawn
reviews.text: We were 3 hours from home and the starter went on my 2013 Hyundai Sonata. The shop was only a couple miles from our hotel. Within 30 minutes, a tow truck picked up the car, dropped it at Pop's, and they had it repaired within 4 hours. Met Tom Green (owner) and felt he was 100% honest with us. I do my own vehicle maintenance, but couldn't, of course. Not only highly recommended, but would not think twice about returning.

reviews.author: Al Maki
reviews.text: Took my car here to get a check engine light looked at while visiting on holiday. Fixed it for me quickly and properly. Technician spoke to me personally about what the issue was and what needed to be done. Great group of people working there, will certainly use them again anytime I'm in North Myrtle.

reviews.author: Peter Thomas
reviews.text: "Pop" is one of the nicest folks I have met here in Myrtle. Caleb quicky had our low tire checked, took the wheel off, and while resetting the bead spotted a crack in the wheel! Surprise! While Pop chatted with us about rescuing dogs, they gave us a temporary patch with bead seal and sent us on our way. Total cost $25, total time less than half an hour! If you want a mechanic who will treat you fairly and quickly, this is the shop to go to in NMB.

reviews.author: Mandi Moser
reviews.text: Car wouldn’t go into gear and had it towed on Sunday memorial Day was on Monday so they were closed and on Tuesday they opened at 8:00 our car was fixed and ready by 9:00 am. Great price honesty and great customer service will always use them for sure if needed on vacation here.

reviews.author: Victoria Seger
reviews.text: We have used Pop's garage numerous time and have had reliable service and good prices. They also know there is one driver in our family and always make special accommodations for us. We highly recommend Pop's garage. Thank you Tom Alex and staff.

reviews.author: David Bessent
reviews.text: Are you kidding me Tom and the gang down at pops they are always on time. You know how you can tell a good garage is when you don't see any cars parked overnight out in front of it. They're honest is the day is long and will go out of their way to help you I've been a customer since the last phone number. Kudos to Tom and the guys and we don't forget Miss Sunshine.

reviews.author: Ron Green
reviews.text: Picked up a screw in my tire while on vacation. Was heading out to one of the big tire shops and noticed Pop's was only a couple of blocks from where I was staying. Pulled in and asked if they could do the repair. Kevin stopped what he was doing and did repair in less than 10 minutes. Had me on my way quick so I could enjoy the remainder of.my vacation. Thanks!

reviews.author: Brandan Weaver
reviews.text: One of the most genuine repair shops I have visited. Even with a full schedule the owner personally took the time to fit me in. Pop's wants you to be a satisfied customer for life. This is not your franchise repair shop that wants to upsale you. This is a family oriented business that gives you what you need at a reasonable price. I reccomend Pop's for all your automotive needs. No one wants to go to the reair shop but when you do you will get the personal service that is important. Thank you for the great and friendly service.

reviews.author: Aric Mcelhattan
reviews.text: Came here in a vehicle that was an unfortunate ticking time bomb. Pops took care of my vehicle and even were honest enough to tell me who could do it quicker as this was the last day of a family trip, but I stuck with Pop's and I am glad I did! I could not ask for better service and I am so thankful that I can trust my family's safety. If I am ever near the area again and in need of service, Pop's is the only place I will go. Thank you Pop's!

reviews.author: susan furr
reviews.text: Great work on repairing my 2008 Honda CRV. Diagnosed the starter as faulty, replaced and reinstalled the new unit. They were able to make a quick diagnosis and quickly fixed this issue. This is my first time going to POP'S and I will return. Easy to work with and stayed in communication with me throughout the repair.

reviews.author: Sue S
reviews.text: Excellent, honest, efficient, personable service!!! My AC blower died in the 109*F heat index and they fit me in at a reasonable price. I will definitely return in the future. Thanks so much guys!!! 10 stars!!!

reviews.author: Ross Peacock
reviews.text: Came in on vacation with noisy rear brake. Angel showed me wear and rust all-round, with safety concerns. Needed all rotors and pads. Work was done next day exactly as promised. Best part, Pop's price, with premium parts, was under what my big-name garage at home offered. Great work!

reviews.author: T Beck
reviews.text: Tom and his team At Pop’s are top notch. Very professional, reasonable, and very friendly. I’ve had them preform maintenance and repairs 2x so far, and because of the way they treat customers, They will always get my business!

reviews.author: Kristin Leggett
reviews.text: Friendly, honest and reasonably priced service. They provided same day service, even though a part needed was on the south end of the beach. The owner thoroughly explained the repairs my car needed to me, as well as other patrons. Highly recommend Pop's:)

reviews.author: Ivy Briggs
reviews.text: Caleb put a plug in my tire in less than 10 minutes! Honest, easy to work with, fabulous people! Let them fix your car at the beach!!! Thank you!

reviews.author: Shawn Barnett
reviews.text: Pop's Garage was great help to us. We were on vacation when the radiator blew. They fixed it in a very timely manner and were very helpful to us. Tom was our contact and very helpful!

reviews.author: Jonathan Murr
reviews.text: Rude, unprofessional, waste of time, lied. Called to make an appointment to have my 2010 Dodge Ram trucks rear differential oil checked and gave them a full description of the truck and what needs to be done on the phone and they agreed to do the job. When I got there and waited for a short period of time the man in charge refused to do the job because it wasn’t a high paying job that would only take ten minutes. They claimed that my truck was lifted and wouldn’t fit on their lift. The truck is stock height. Here’s the issue to fix the truck it was not a job that required the truck to be lifted off the ground and I didn’t want the seal replaced just check the oil and fill if needed. Huge waste of time and a let down after hearing from them and others that it was a good place to go.

reviews.author: Pam Mangum
reviews.text: The most honest and reliable service I've ever gotten from a mechanic .And treat you like family. I'll never take my car anywhere else. I highly recommend them. Thank you Pop's Garage.

reviews.author: Lonnie Rettig
reviews.text: Came in from from Ohio. Had a plug foul out and brought it in. Turned out gasket blew, leaking on coil kicking off code. Huge thank you for a crisis resoved. Also thank you for Good convo.

reviews.author: Chris Weber
reviews.text: We were visiting from out of town and Pop’s fixed my tire! We had gotten glass in it on the trip down. They took GREAT care of us and were incredibly expedient! Thank y’all so much!

reviews.author: Kailey Bryant
reviews.text: This will SOLEY be the only place I go for my vehicle repairs & maintenance. When another place tried to over charge me 450$, they helped me to get out of a bad situation, didn’t take advantage of me & were so kind and helpful! Thank you all so much for your hard work!! See you again!!

reviews.author: Paul Bullock
reviews.text: The folks at Pop's are great to deal with. Tom, Alex and the entire crew are very in tune with customer needs and very reasonable. I highly recommend them for your car service needs.

reviews.author: William Boehly
reviews.text: This is the place to go for your auto repair needs! They are a small business and really could use your business in these trying times. They are very honest and inexpensive. They will not push more work that is required on your car unless it is a safety issue.. Very pleased with the professional and friendly staff. Please support this local business! Bill Boehly

reviews.author: Donny
reviews.text: Had a rod in my tire making a slow leak. Pulled in told them my problem and was fixed up and out in 15min. Great service, great price, and awesome personality of staff!

reviews.author: Elinor Bolli
reviews.text: Fast. friendly, professional service. Knowledgeable mechanics. Went above & beyond to repair my car. Will not hesitate to recommend this garage to anyone & everyone needing routine maintenance right up to major repair.

reviews.author: Susan Cook
reviews.text: Came down on vacation, our family experienced unexpected vehicle problems. They fit me in right away that day with no appointment. Great customer service and reasonable rates

reviews.author: Steve Gardner
reviews.text: Saved the day. In town for our son's wedding, lots of errands to run; wrong time for a tire to be going flat. Repaired it while I waited-- super fast. And price was great.

reviews.author: Michael Rue
reviews.text: Pop’s has been my go to for alignments repairs for 20 plus years. Honest and fair. They will get you back on the road. Local

reviews.author: autumn george
reviews.text: This place is the best! Everyone was so nice and they got my tire fixed in no time! Came in with a nail in my tire and they fixed in super fast and easy! Definitely would recommend this place!!

reviews.author: Minister Michael
reviews.text: It was a nice friendly place. I would highly recommend it. Prices were fair and the service was great. Trying to find a good mechanic when you are new to the area can be difficult, they made it easy.

reviews.author: Bette Ferree
reviews.text: Needed help with tire pressure since car light on. They were so kind to help. Found spare tire needed more air which corrected car light. I would return to Pop's if needed when in Cherry Grove, SC.

reviews.author: Cindy Dyer6
reviews.text: It was so refreshing to walk into an establishment where the folks are super friendly, honest and very knowledgeable. I will go no place else for my car needs. Super happy I get to support a local business owner!!

reviews.author: Mike Little
reviews.text: I was unfortunate to pick up a nail after everything was closed. I call POP's in the morning and was told to stop in. They repaired it and checked the other 3 and I was on my way in 15 minutes. Great service at a good price

reviews.author: Frank Hedrick
reviews.text: Went to Pop’s this morning with my car overheating. The staff was friendly and very accommodating. Had my car fixed within the hour. I highly recommend Pop’s!! Thank you

reviews.author: Michael Kuchera
reviews.text: Can't say enough about the crew at Pop's Garage, they are courteous and fast! I highly recommend Pop's Garage for your automotive needs.

reviews.author: Tina Champagne
reviews.text: I have been here a few times, I'm new to area and just yesterday when my nephew and his wife came to visit their car broke down. You guys were amazing and very fair, today they are heading home and I feel great knowing the car got fixed by the best in town.. thanks guys

reviews.author: Michael Lessar
reviews.text: Friendly employees, fixed our truck in a respectable amount of time. The price was fairly decent. Overall very pleased.

reviews.author: Clady Grace Farkaschek
reviews.text: Professional, trustworthy, kind and knows their stuff!! Will always have my services done here from now on! Thank you!

reviews.author: Annette Masouras
reviews.text: Tom and his crew are good ppl. Quality work excellent price and service! Big shout out to Alex. Thanks for the ride!

reviews.author: Natasha Kreuger
reviews.text: Front desk was incredibly helpful from start to finish and I did not feel that any time was wasted when it came to working on my car. An appointment actually means something here.

reviews.author: DAVID Pate
reviews.text: I was told by Tom it would be $340 to repair my car. When I picked it up it was $447.Some guy named Bret shot me a load of BS .Tom had the day off.Don't screw the locals. I will not go back.

reviews.author: Thomas Bavero
reviews.text: they took my car in the next day, took the time to explain in detail what was wrong. I'll trust them going forward with all our cars. nice people.

reviews.author: Richard Jansen
reviews.text: My experience with them has been very positive. They don't overcharge, they call before doing work that might be important but wasn't part of the estimate. They also take appointments

reviews.author: Sonny Wolff
reviews.text: When dealing with a mechanic you do not want to be over charged and that's what this place did to me ... would have not minded as much if they would have fixed the problem but was told they could not figure it out. 4 days and 500 dollars later

reviews.author: Randy Bass
reviews.text: Second time taking vehicle to Pops, both times everybody very nice and took care of my automotive needs promptly! Highly recommend Pops Garage

reviews.author: Melissa Rakitsky
reviews.text: They were able to get me in quickly, there was a fast turn around on my car and they staff is both friendly and very knowledgeable. I would highly recommended them.

reviews.author: Nic Fabb
reviews.text: Worst shop experience I have ever had the owner denied me service due to a broken door handle. Claims he is an ASE certified tech but is scared of a door handle. Then called my car a piece of junk, do not waste your time with this joke of a shop

reviews.author: Sanice Olivera
reviews.text: Great customer service, excellent mechanics at this workshop. Highly recommended. Ask for Angel, he will take good care of you

reviews.author: John M
reviews.text: Leaking tire (embedded nail) fixed right away. Excellent customer service. Would highly recommend Pop's Garage.

reviews.author: Se-In Park
reviews.text: Felt like getting a little over charged for simple services, but did not get ripped off so I gave two stars. If I had not been an out of towner, I'd have not come here.

reviews.author: Salty Balls
reviews.text: Professional family type atmosphere always friendly staff. POPS GARAGE will always be my one stop for my car!

reviews.author: Pamela Wise
reviews.text: Friendly, staff very knowledgeable about their business. Able to do repairs without much delay. Staff give 110 percent, as the owner gives 150 percent!

reviews.author: Bj Richardson
reviews.text: Walked in with a power steering leak on my wife's car, expecting to leave it, and they took it straight in. Nice crew there.

reviews.author: Tedarrell McAfee
reviews.text: BESIDE THE OWNER OF POP'S GARAGE BEING A PHENOMENAL MECHANIC , HE IS A GREAT PERSON WITH EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE. I CALLED SEVERAL MAJOR SHOPS AROUND TOWN THAT HAD NO INTEREST IN JUST DX MY CAR WITHIN A REASONABLE TIME FRAME. I CALLED MR. TOM AT POPS GARAGED, HE LET ME DROP MY KEY OFF THAT NIGHT AND IT WAS FIXED THE NEXT DAY, THE MAN EVEN WAITED AFTER CLOSING HRS UNTIL I COULD GET OFF FROM WORK TO COME GET MY CAR. NOTHING ELSE SAID BUT GREAT PLACE, ME AND MY WIFE WONT GO ANYWHERE ELSE. HE EVEN GIVES OUT CROSS KEY CHAIN. GREAT PLACE REALLY GLAD I FOUND IT IN NORTH MB.

reviews.author: Kathie Savage
reviews.text: I had a small accident while driving a friend's car. We went to Pop's, they took it right in, and then fixed it for half of what we expected it would cost in half the time we expected it would take. Such a relief.

reviews.author: Dom
reviews.text: Great local auto shop. Excellent prices, very personable staff, and they now have a customer for life.

reviews.author: William Hunter
reviews.text: Needed heat shield rattle addressed on vacation. Pop's service was prompt ,curtious, and priced fairly

reviews.author: Brad Funderburk
reviews.text: Always fair on pricing and great work...an honest mechanic is hard to find ....Tom and his crew are too notch

reviews.author: Darlene Little
reviews.text: They seem to be very honest...they tell you everything up front...need more businesses like this...nice to find someone who is honest in their business...would highly recommend them

reviews.author: chad perkins
reviews.text: Thank you!! Shop was closed for the day and he opened up to fix our tire so we were not stranded on the side of the road later.

reviews.author: Donald Morgan
reviews.text: Good and honest service performed by this place. I do Roadside Assistance and recommend this place to anyone I can't help

reviews.author: Carolann McGraw
reviews.text: The guys at pop's are the sweetest things! My friend Giovanna has been a long time client of theirs and when I needed a trip check for a long road trip she recommended them to me. And oh my goodness, I will absolutely be coming back. The guy I spoke to over the phone making the appointment was very professional and got me set up for the next Monday, no problem. I dropped my car off Sunday night. I got a call at 9am Monday about the trip check and what all needed to get done. They answered my questions, broke down the price and the work requirements and the labor cost.... They made sure I felt informed on what they were doing to my car. And they went above and beyond! In the 11 years I've had my Honda, it's never run this smooth! My car was ready around 1pm and when I picked it up at 4:50, you could tell they were just so friendly. I talked with the guy at the counter about the car, he recommended a few extra things that they had seen but weren't mandatory and sent me on my way. Satisfied doesn't even begin to describe how happy I am with their customer service and work! In all the mechanics I've tried living down here... They are the best! Also very reasonable prices in my opinion.
